reason: Both are branded packaged-snack companies selling to the same retail channels: grocery, mass, club and convenience. The products differ. Simply Good Foods sells protein and nutrition bars, shakes and snacks aimed at health-conscious consumers. Tootsie sells candy, such as chewy candies, lollipops, mints and gum. Tootsie also manufactures in its own plants, while Simply Good Foods is a brand owner.
